quadrature: normalized trapezoidal weights on each recorded grid; equal block weights
incomplete_candidates: completion priority only; no truncated measured fit score
force_support: native measured times within preintegration simulation support; no extrapolation
angle_convention: ground foot pitch; positive toe-up; fixed shoe frame
policy: raw simulation at every timestep, pre-20Hz cleaned reference only interpolated
supplemental: foot pitch(.05rad scale,.25weight), onset plane velocity(.5m/s scale,.1weight), phase impulses/peaks/centroids and early braking
effort_guard_note: 1.5x peak and2x rate of old controller with this fixed contact model; additional engineering guards, not physiological limits
tracking_gate_note: Quadratic hinge on training_margin times the original six RMSE thresholds. Original validation limits remain unchanged and are evaluated separately.

ap_force_rate_residual.source: prepared reference grf_target_n (native force samples; filter provenance unverified)
ap_force_rate_residual.simulated_force: unfiltered engine AP force sampled at the native GRF clock
ap_force_rate_residual.target_rate: first difference of adjacent supplied native AP GRF samples; not bandwidth-calibrated
ap_force_rate_residual.weight: one time-normalized residual block over the full native force support
